description: Land Acquisition - Ambalanwatta, Mirigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No.1997/29 of 16.12.2016, Ex. Gaz. No. 1974/28 of 08.07.2016
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively concerns land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels, including lot numbers, land descriptions, extents, and claimant information. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, and appears in the "PART III - LANDS" section of the gazette.
